summary: The root مَحَا (maḥā) means to efface, erase, or obliterate something, removing its trace or impression.
lane: 1 مَحَاهُ ذ He effaced, erased, rased, obliterated, or cancelled, it; removed, or did away with, its impression or trace. (K.) -b2- مَحَتِ الرِّيحُ عَنْهُ الأَسْقَامَ وَالدُّنُوبَ The wind made to pass away, or dispelled, the clouds. (TA.) -b3- مَحَا الصُّبْحُ اللَّيْلَ Daybreak dispelled the night. (TA.) -b4- مَحَاٱللّٰهُ عَنْهُ الأَسْقَامَ وَالدُّنُوبَ [ God removed from him diseases and sins; as though He cancelled them]. (Msb in art. عفو .) -b5- الإِحْسَانُ يَمْحُو الإِسَآءَةَ Beneficence effaces, obliterates, or cancels, evil conduct. (TA)
